---
title: "Lightbox: off"
# bd-kcpkgftw. Port of Q1 smoke-all/lightbox/lightbox-off.qmd.
# `lightbox: false` disables the feature for the whole document, even for
# images that carry the explicit `.lightbox` class (Q1 skips the filter
# entirely), and nothing is shipped.
lightbox: false
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'figure img[src="images/mv-0.png"]'
        - - 'a.lightbox'
          - 'script[src$="glightbox/glightbox.min.js"]'
          - 'link[href$="glightbox/glightbox.min.css"]'
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - []
        - ["GLightbox"]
---

![Beach in Chilmark](images/mv-0.png)

![Explicit, but off](images/mv-1.png){.lightbox}
